controls.name: Switch: Map, Ranked, Cards
controls.what: Chooses the view; Map is open by default.

controls.name: "5 roles tested" link
controls.what: A link to the list of roles.
controls.from: Stitch frame. Not built: the chips show the roles (0069).

controls.name: Role chips
controls.what: Main session, Shipping, then Building, Judgment, Investigating, Learning, Panels, Workers; a second row narrows to one role line.
notes: Stitch's names (Coder, Reviewer, Researcher) are replaced (0059).

controls.name: Title and "Interactive" badge
controls.from: Fixed text; the badge is Stitch frame, not built (0069).

controls.name: Bubble chart
controls.what: Each model in the role is a bubble: across is cost per slice, up is fewer HITL interventions per slice, size is slices run.
controls.from: The runner's kept record (0041), credited to the model that answered (0052, 0057, 0058).
notes: A model with fewer than 10 slices is dashed, "too few slices to trust yet" (0058). Overlapping bubbles in the picture are a drawing flaw.

controls.name: Zone
controls.what: Models cheaper and with fewer interventions than the role's median, labelled "Cheaper and fewer interventions than most".
controls.from: Computed from the role's own medians (0062).
notes: The stray "RK" is a drawing flaw.

controls.name: Tapped model panel
controls.what: The chosen model's cost per slice and HITL interventions per slice, each against the role's other models.

controls.name: Tile "HITL interventions"
controls.what: Interventions per slice and their time, better or worse than most.

controls.name: Tile "Second-round rate"
controls.what: How often this model's slices needed a second round, against the role's median.

controls.name: "Where trouble came from"
controls.what: The share of interventions whose root-cause stage was requirements, design or build.

controls.name: Compactions per slice (not drawn)
controls.what: A fifth bar, against the role's other models; tapping shows the fullest context reached on average.

controls.name: Suggestion
controls.what: Written weekly by an agent from the recorded numbers, quoting them; shown only where two models in the role have 10 slices.

controls.name: Empty, loading and failed (not drawn)
controls.what: Empty: "No finished slices yet. Numbers appear when the first card finishes." Loading: grey placeholders. Failed: "Server unavailable" with Try again.
